exposure: hysteroscopic surgery for endogenous cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
prophylactic ultrasound-guided local injection of lauromacrogol
cohort: 131 patients diagnosed with endogenous cesarean scar pregnancy who underwent hysteroscopic surgery at the Hangzhou Fuyang Women and Children Hospital between January 2018 and May 2022
finding: Hysteroscopic surgery is effective and safe for patients with endogenous cesarean scar pregnancy, but prophylactic lauromacrogol injection increases the incidence of complications and costs.
